sentences.text: Lithoptila abdounensis was an extinct seabird belonging to the family Prophaethontidae that lived during the Palaeogene period.
This animal is a distant relative of modern tropicbirds.
The genus Lithoptila was named by Bourdon in 2005, describing the species Lithoptila abdounensis.
Fossils of L. abdounensis have been found in Morocco in strata dating to the Late Palaeocene and Early Eocene.
The genus Lithoptila lived between 61.66 and 48.07 million years ago, from the Selandian to the Ypresian.
